Sound familiar?

You’re good at your job. You just don’t want it anymore.

  • Sunday evening arrives and the week ahead already feels heavy.
  • You’ve thought about leaving for months, but don’t know what you’d go towards.
  • Every idea sounds either too safe or too risky, so nothing happens.
  • You’ve read the articles and taken the quizzes, and you’re still circling.

Here’s what you’ll do

Seven days, one clear next move

Get out of circling mode

Why you keep going round in circles, and how to make decisions from a calm, clear head.

Map what matters now

Your values and non-negotiables for this chapter, not the one you planned at 22.

Find your patterns

The patterns that have kept you stuck in roles that don’t fit, and what to do instead.

List your real options

New role, new field, or your own thing. Every option on paper, with no judgement.

Score them

Run your options through the Next-Move Decision Matrix and see which one rises to the top.

Build self-trust

How to hear your own yes over everyone else’s opinion.

Commit to your next step

One clear move, one first action, and a date to take it.

Meet Emily

Hi, I’m Emily Liou

I’m a certified career coach and former recruiter. Years ago I left a toxic job without another one lined up, started writing about it, and that blog became CultiVitae.

Today I help high-achieving women in mid-to-senior careers get clear on what’s next and build the courage to go after it. 33.3k people follow along on Instagram, and my Inner Magic programme works through three phases:

Questions

Before you start

Is this resume and interview help?

Not first. The Sprint is about deciding what you actually want next. Once you know, the job search gets much easier.

How much time does it take?

About 20 to 30 minutes a day for seven days. Go at your own pace; you keep lifetime access.

What if I want my own business, not a new job?

That’s one of the options you’ll map and score on Day 4 and Day 5.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy to take. Do the seven days, then decide if you want to go deeper.
